name: ostin-pil-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for a solo or small-team dev workflow, driven by a shared per-project manifest: session lifecycle (lifecycle-kit), knowledge base and issue tracking (knowledge-kit), and a deterministic AI-prose linter (prose-mint).

plugins.name: lifecycle-kit
plugins.description: Session lifecycle and reporting skills driven by a per-project manifest: session-start, session-report, session-end, finalize-worktree, cleanup-worktrees, report.

plugins.name: prose-mint
plugins.description: Structural-tells linter for AI-flavored prose: scan files, PR bodies, or piped text for em dashes, arrows, not-X-but-Y, bold-colon openers, AI-attribution boilerplate, hard-wraps. Bundles the prose-check skill, a /prose-check command, and an MCP server.

plugins.name: knowledge-kit
plugins.description: Knowledge-base skills driven by the lifecycle manifest: knowledge-audit (orphaned/stale/unpromoted check), issues (ISS-NNN tracker), and session-archive (scrubbed transcript export). Ships a knowledge-skeleton template and the two git-hook templates.
